pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients and low-frequency pixel-level irregularities along the boundaries. The spatial area of individual patches is high relative to the inter-patch negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected high-luminance corridors forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. Corridor thickness is narrow and remains consistent across the lateral torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane along the neck ridge. The silhouette exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth geometric contour against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Significant region of high-entropy textural disruption on the central and upper-lateral flank. The area is characterized by grey-brown crusting and loss of discrete patch-corridor boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large localized epidermal lesion on the flank exhibiting rugose skin thickening and pigment loss, disrupting the typical pelage pattern.
